test_cases.test_name: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow
test_cases.objective: Verify that documents can be successfully assigned to users and groups, and that users can complete the electronic acknowledgment process as per the vendor's standard workflow.
prerequisites: System installation is complete and verified
Test user accounts created with different roles
Test document uploaded into the system
Active Directory groups configured if applicable

test_steps.action: Log into the system as an administrator and navigate to the document assignment module.
test_steps.expected_result: Administrator successfully logs in and can access the document assignment interface.

test_steps.action: Assign the test document to a specific test user and a predefined test user group using the vendor UI.
test_steps.expected_result: System confirms the assignment and the document appears in the assigned tasks for the targeted user and group.

test_steps.action: Log out and log in as the test user. Navigate to the user's acknowledgment dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: User sees the assigned document in their pending acknowledgments list.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of user dashboard showing pending acknowledgment

test_steps.action: Open the assigned document, review it, and complete the vendor-provided electronic signature/acknowledgment process.
test_steps.expected_result: System records the acknowledgment, including a timestamp and electronic signature, and removes the document from the pending list.

test_steps.action: Log back in as the administrator and run the standard acknowledgment report for the test document.
test_steps.expected_result: Report generates successfully and shows the test user's acknowledgment with correct details.
data_to_capture: Screenshot or export of the generated report

acceptance_criteria: Document assignment to user and group is successful.
User can see and access the assigned document for acknowledgment.
Electronic acknowledgment process completes without errors.
Acknowledgment is recorded with a compliant electronic signature and timestamp.
Standard report accurately reflects the acknowledgment status.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
data_integrity_requirements: Acknowledgment records must be complete, accurate, and protected from unauthorized modification.
Audit trail must capture the assignment and acknowledgment events.

test_cases.test_name: Automated Reminder and Manager Dashboard Verification
test_cases.objective: Validate the system's automated reminder functionality and the role-based dashboard views available to managers for tracking acknowledgment status.
prerequisites: System installation is complete and verified
Test document assigned to a user but not yet acknowledged
Manager-level test account created
Vendor scheduler is configured for reminders

test_steps.action: As an administrator, configure the vendor scheduler to send a reminder for overdue acknowledgments (e.g., set a short interval for testing).
test_steps.expected_result: Scheduler configuration is saved successfully.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled reminder time to pass or manually trigger the reminder process as per vendor instructions.
test_steps.expected_result: The test user receives an automated reminder notification (email or system alert) for the unacknowledged document.
data_to_capture: Screenshot or copy of the reminder notification received by the user

test_steps.action: Log into the system using the manager-level test account and access the role-based dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: Manager dashboard loads successfully, showing an overview of acknowledgment statuses.

test_steps.action: Use the dashboard filters or views to check the status of the test document assigned to the test user.
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard accurately displays the test document as 'assigned' or 'pending acknowledgment' for the specific user.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the filtered dashboard view showing the test assignment

test_steps.action: Generate a standard acknowledgment report from the manager dashboard for the test user/group.
test_steps.expected_result: Report generates in less than 10 seconds and accurately lists the acknowledgment status.
data_to_capture: Time taken to generate the report

acceptance_criteria: Automated reminder is sent according to the scheduled configuration.
Manager role-based dashboard provides a clear overview of acknowledgment statuses.
Dashboard filters and reports function correctly and display accurate data.
Report generation meets the performance requirement of <10 seconds.
regulatory_basis: Internal Quality Management System requirements for tracking training and awareness.
data_integrity_requirements: Data presented on the dashboard and reports must be a real-time reflection of the system's current state.

test_cases.test_name: High Volume Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Performance Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can handle 10,000 document assignments per day and generate reports for 50k records in under 10 seconds as specified in performance requirements.
prerequisites: Test environment with performance monitoring tools
Test dataset of 10,000 users and documents
Pre-configured performance baseline metrics

test_steps.action: Load test environment and configure performance monitoring tools to track system response times
test_steps.expected_result: Performance monitoring tools are active and capturing system metrics accurately
data_to_capture: System resource utilization (CPU, memory, disk I/O)

test_steps.action: Execute batch process to assign 10,000 documents to various users and groups simultaneously
test_steps.expected_result: All 10,000 document assignments are processed successfully without system failure
data_to_capture: Number of successful vs failed assignments
System performance metrics during peak load

test_steps.action: Generate standard acknowledgment report for a dataset containing 50,000 records
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes in less than 10 seconds as specified in performance requirements
data_to_capture: System resource usage during report generation

acceptance_criteria: System processes 10,000 assignments within acceptable performance thresholds
Report generation completes in under 10 seconds for 50k records
No system crashes or critical errors during high volume processing
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements
data_integrity_requirements: All assignment transactions must be complete and accurate
Report data must match source system records exactly
No data corruption during high volume processing
urs_requirements: URS-021-009: Report generation < 10 seconds for 50k records
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow

test_cases.test_name: Active Directory Integration and User Group Synchronization Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system correctly synchronizes user groups from Active Directory using the standard vendor-provided connector
prerequisites: Test Active Directory environment
Configured AD connector
Test user groups in Active Directory
Access to system administration console

test_steps.action: Configure the standard AD connector in the document acknowledgment system using vendor documentation
test_steps.expected_result: AD connector is properly configured and shows successful connection to test Active Directory

test_steps.action: Initiate manual synchronization of user groups from Active Directory to the document acknowledgment system
test_steps.expected_result: Synchronization process completes successfully without errors

test_steps.action: Verify synchronized user groups appear correctly in the document acknowledgment system's user management interface
test_steps.expected_result: All Active Directory user groups are accurately represented in the document acknowledgment system with correct membership
data_to_capture: Any discrepancies between AD and system

test_steps.action: Test document assignment to a synchronized AD group and verify members receive the assignment
test_steps.expected_result: Document assignment to AD group functions correctly and all group members receive the assignment

acceptance_criteria: AD connector successfully synchronizes all user groups
Synchronized groups maintain accurate membership information
Document assignments to AD groups function correctly
No data loss during synchronization process
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 access controls requirements
data_integrity_requirements: User group data must remain consistent between AD and document system
No unauthorized modifications to group membership during synchronization
Audit trail must record all synchronization activities
urs_requirements: URS-021-010: Sync user groups from AD via standard connector
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow

test_cases.test_name: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments
test_cases.objective: Verify the system maintains a complete and unalterable audit trail for all document assignment and acknowledgment activities as required by regulatory standards.
prerequisites: System administrator access
At least one document assigned to a user
At least one completed user acknowledgment

test_steps.action: Log in to the system as an administrator and navigate to the audit trail reporting module.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail interface loads successfully, showing filter options for date, user, and event type.
data_to_capture: Time to load audit trail interface

test_steps.action: Apply filters to search for audit events related to the creation of a document assignment.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays audit records showing the assignment creation event, including timestamp, user who performed the action, and document details.

test_steps.action: Apply filters to search for audit events related to a user acknowledging a document.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays audit records showing the acknowledgment event, including timestamp, user who acknowledged, and document identifier.

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify any audit trail entry using administrative privileges.
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents any modifications to audit trail records, displaying an error message or read-only interface.

acceptance_criteria: All assignment and acknowledgment events are recorded in the audit trail
Audit trail entries contain complete information including timestamp, user, and action details
Audit trail records cannot be modified or deleted by any user
data_integrity_requirements: ALCOA+ principles must be maintained for all audit trail records
Audit trail must be time-stamped and cannot be disabled
urs_requirements: URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system properly maintains acknowledgment records according to the configured retention policy and prevents premature deletion.
prerequisites: System administrator access
Retention policy configured in system
Acknowledgment records older than retention period available

test_steps.action: Log in to the system as an administrator and navigate to the retention policy configuration.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the current retention policy settings for acknowledgment records.

test_steps.action: Identify acknowledgment records that have exceeded the retention period but should not yet be deleted.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays records that are within the retention policy timeframe and prevents access to deletion functions.
data_to_capture: Availability of records within retention period
System behavior when deletion is attempted

test_steps.action: Run the system's retention policy enforcement process (manual or automated).
test_steps.expected_result: System processes retention rules and appropriately archives or deletes records according to the configured policy.

test_steps.action: Verify that records marked for deletion are properly removed or archived according to the retention policy.
test_steps.expected_result: System maintains an accurate record of deleted/archived documents and provides confirmation of compliance with retention policy.

acceptance_criteria: System enforces configured retention policies for acknowledgment records
Records are not deleted before their retention period expires
Deletion/archiving process is properly documented and verifiable
System prevents unauthorized modification of retention policies
regulatory_basis: EU GMP Chapter 4 - Documentation - retention requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Records must be retained for the required period per documented policy
Deletion of records must follow documented procedures with appropriate controls
urs_requirements: URS-021-006: Maintain acknowledgment records per retention policy
related_tests: OQ-005: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Dashboard Access and Functionality Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that role-based dashboards provide appropriate access and functionality to managers as specified in URS-021-004
prerequisites: System is installed and configured
Test users with different role levels created
Document assignments exist for testing
Manager accounts with appropriate permissions configured

test_steps.action: Log in as a Quality Manager with full dashboard access privileges
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard loads successfully with complete set of reporting and monitoring features visible

test_steps.action: Navigate to the acknowledgment tracking section and verify all document assignment statistics are displayed
test_steps.expected_result: Complete statistics including pending, completed, and overdue acknowledgments are visible with accurate counts

test_steps.action: Log in as a Department Supervisor with limited dashboard access
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard loads with restricted features appropriate for supervisor role level

acceptance_criteria: All role-based dashboards display appropriate content based on user permissions
Dashboard data accurately reflects current acknowledgment status
Access restrictions prevent unauthorized users from viewing sensitive information
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic records and signatures
data_integrity_requirements: Dashboard must display accurate, real-time data from the acknowledgment database
Role-based access controls must prevent unauthorized data access
All displayed statistics must be traceable to source records
urs_requirements: URS-021-004: Provide role-based dashboards for managers
related_tests: OQ-002: Automated Reminder and Manager Dashboard Verification

test_cases.test_name: Electronic Signature Compliance and Validation Test
test_cases.objective: Verify that electronic acknowledgment signatures comply with regulatory requirements and maintain proper audit trail integrity
prerequisites: System configured for electronic signatures
Test users with document assignments
Audit trail functionality enabled
Signature policy configured per regulatory requirements

test_steps.action: Assign a test document to a user and have them complete the acknowledgment process
test_steps.expected_result: System captures electronic signature with timestamp, user identity, and meaning of signature

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail entry for the acknowledgment event
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail contains complete record of signature event including all required 21 CFR Part 11 elements

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify an acknowledged document record and verify signature protection
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents modification of signed records and maintains signature binding integrity

acceptance_criteria: Electronic signatures comply with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements
Audit trail captures all signature events with complete metadata
Signed records are protected from unauthorized modification
Signature meaning is clearly stated and recorded
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic signatures must be securely bound to their respective records
Signature metadata must be complete and unalterable
Audit trail must capture all signature-related events in chronological order
urs_requirements: URS-021-005: Support vendor-provided electronic acknowledgment signature
URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow
OQ-005: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments

test_cases.test_name: Standard Acknowledgment Report Generation and Format Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system generates standard acknowledgment reports correctly and that the report format meets business requirements
prerequisites: System is operational and accessible
Test documents assigned to users
Acknowledgment records exist in the system
User with report generation permissions is logged in

test_steps.action: Navigate to the report generation module using the vendor UI
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation interface loads successfully with available report options

test_steps.action: Select the standard acknowledgment report template and specify date range parameters
test_steps.expected_result: Report parameters are accepted and date range validation is applied correctly

test_steps.action: Generate the acknowledgment report for approximately 50,000 records
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes successfully within 10 seconds

test_steps.action: Verify report content includes all required fields: user name, document title, acknowledgment date, and status
test_steps.expected_result: Report contains all mandatory data fields with accurate information

test_steps.action: Export the report to standard formats (PDF, CSV, Excel) and verify file integrity
test_steps.expected_result: Reports export successfully in all available formats without data corruption

acceptance_criteria: Report generation completes within 10 seconds for 50k records
All required data fields are present and accurate in the report
Reports export successfully to all available formats without data loss
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records
EU Annex 11 requirements for computerized systems
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must accurately reflect the acknowledgment records in the database
No data manipulation or corruption during report generation or export
urs_requirements: URS-021-009: Report generation < 10 seconds for 50k records
related_tests: OQ-003: High Volume Document Assignment and Acknowledgment Performance Test
OQ-005: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignments and Acknowledgments

test_cases.test_name: User Group Assignment and Management via Vendor UI
test_cases.objective: Verify that document assignments can be properly managed for user groups through the vendor-provided user interface
prerequisites: System is operational and accessible
Active Directory groups are synchronized
Test documents available for assignment
User with administrative permissions is logged in

test_steps.action: Navigate to the document assignment module using the vendor UI
test_steps.expected_result: Document assignment interface loads successfully with available options

test_steps.action: Select a test document and choose to assign it to a synchronized AD group rather than individual users
test_steps.expected_result: System displays available AD groups and allows selection for assignment

test_steps.action: Complete the assignment process for multiple AD groups and set acknowledgment due dates
test_steps.expected_result: Assignment is successfully created for all group members with correct due dates

test_steps.action: Verify that all members of the assigned groups receive the document assignment in their acknowledgment queue
test_steps.expected_result: All group members show the assigned document in their pending acknowledgments

test_steps.action: Test modifying and removing group assignments through the vendor UI
test_steps.expected_result: Assignment modifications and removals are processed correctly and reflected in user queues

acceptance_criteria: Document assignments can be successfully created for AD groups
All group members receive the assignment correctly
Assignment modifications and removals are processed accurately
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for electronic signatures and records
EU GMP Annex 11 for electronic systems
data_integrity_requirements: Assignment records must be accurately created and maintained
Group membership changes must be reflected in assignment distribution
urs_requirements: URS-021-001: Assign documents to users and groups using vendor UI
URS-021-010: Sync user groups from AD via standard connector
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Electronic Acknowledgment Workflow
OQ-004: Active Directory Integration and User Group Synchronization Test
